newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - October 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - October 30.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Wednesday's edition of Daily Variety:
HOLLYWOOD - News Corp Ltd has promoted Peter Chernin of its 20th Century Fox unit to president and chief operating officer of News Corp.
PARIS - France's Canal Plus has secured access to product from Sony Corp's Columbia TriStar International Television in a pay TV and pay-per-view rights deal.
WASHINGTON - Industry groups have reached a tentative agreement on the technology to block digital copying of copyrighted material on pre-recorded discs.
